DST is set apart from its sibling method, Sampling-Invariant Content Transformation (SICT), by handling the style-specific affine transformation (matrix multiplication and bias) in the 2D domain, ensuring that the transformation is mathematically equivalent to point-wise transformation while drastically reducing memory footprint [S1].

The evidence explicitly states that Deferred Style Transformation (DST) applies the style transformation to volume-rendered 2D feature maps rather than 3D point features. The claim accurately reflects these points found in the source text.
